title: King Chulalongkorn Memorial Building
axis: Local +X runs along the building frontage to the north-northwest. Local +Z points toward the approaching paths and reflecting garden, east-northeast.

nativeAxes.z: east-northeast toward the garden and principal pedestrian approach

features.role: Named surveyed building and terrace envelope, with approach connection along its east-northeast side.

identityStatus: Named native OpenStreetMap envelope, the original approach relief grid, two public-domain Qualla views and the municipality’s official pavilion interpretation.

terrainContact.basis: Unchanged regional terrain at the approach immediately outside the modeled plinth.

notes: The map fixes an approximately 16.3 by 14.1 metre envelope. Two cleared photographs fix the white column arcade, raised gray stone terrace, red cross-gables, gold bargeboards, and multiple gold stages supporting the tall royal spire.
